name: experience
label: Experience
description: The object containing the information about the experience

name: controllerPresetMap
label: Controller preset map
description: An object containing all of the available controller presets by sys_id

name: componentPresetMap
label: Component preset map
description: An object containing all of the available component presets by sys_id

name: elementAndDataResourceNameMap
label: Element and data resource name map
description: An object containing all of the element and data resource name/label pairs

name: userRoles
label: User roles
description: An array of roles the current user has

name: formFactors
label: Form factors
description: The array of all form factors currently available for the macroponent

name: dismissedRuleViolations
label: Dismissed rule violations
description: An object containing all rules that have been dismissed

name: appConfigId
label: App config id
description: Sys_id of the app config if the macroponent is a page within an experience

name: extensionPointId
label: Extension point id
description: Sys_id of the extension point if the macroponent is a page within a page collection

name: requestedBuilderContext
label: Requested builder context
description: Array of string names for the builder contexts to be considered by the rules engine

name: initiallySelectedAlert
label: Initially selected alert
description: A string with an 'elementId-ruleSysId' format to immediately select an alert on load

name: screen
label: Screen
description: The screen we are working in
